edits.name: realShape

settings.about: created: what adding made that was not there (file, permissions, allow); afterPrune: after removing, what the app made is taken out again once it is empty, so the bytes are as before (a created file that ends {} is deleted).

remote.about: Remote workspaces (docs/remote-workspaces.md, /v2): the host's run reports the card as a RunEvent of type antigravityPermission; the client's continuation start carries antigravityGrant beside the request, and the host adds only rules it reported (else 403). A reported card's rules are single-use: the first accepted grant takes them out of the host's cache. temporary:false is refused unless the host allows full access from other computers.

request.input: The user has now allowed what was just declined: curl -s https://example.com | grep -i '<title>'. Please continue.

refusals.case: rules the host did not report, or a card already used
temporary false while the host does not allow full access
temporary false for a once-only rule (host allows full access)

mobile.about: docs/mobile-remote.md: the card is one MobilePermission (toolName AntigravityPermission) with an optional antigravity object; POST /m1/sessions/{id}/permission answers it, always only with allow. onceOnly marks an action whose rule may be allowed only once: a card with one offers no 항상 허용, and always on it is refused (409 remote.error.antigravityOnceOnly). onceOnlyReason (risky, interpreter or agyFolder) says why, and picks the card's reason text (onceOnlyReasons); a phone that does not know a reason shows the risky text.

permission.title: Antigravity asks you to allow this

permissionPlain.about: what the Mac sends for the recorded `command` stream's card (id, runId and receivedAt as in permission): 항상 허용 is offered

permission.title: Antigravity asks you to allow this

refusals.case: always on a card with a once-only rule

tools.about: The closed mapping from an agy tool to the permission its rule names; any other tool gets no rule.

rules.about: AntigravityRuleSafety: refused rules are never offered or added; once rules are offered and added only for the follow-up run (no 항상 허용; a host refuses always with 409 remote.error.antigravityOnceOnly); always rules may be kept. File rules (write_file, read_file) need an absolute path and are refused when the path is inside or equal to a protected folder (agy's own ~/.gemini, the app's data folder that holds its ledger) or an ancestor of one; the cases are judged with `context.protected` as the protected folders, compared without case, with / and \ alike and . and .. taken out (the apps add the real folders, symlinks resolved). A command that mentions .gemini is once only. A once rule carries its reason: risky (chains, pipes, redirects, substitutes, background, a destructive program), interpreter (a shell, interpreter or wrapper alone or with an inline-code flag, judged by the first word after any leading VAR=x or env VAR=x; wrappers such as npx, xargs, timeout are once whatever follows) or agyFolder (mentions .gemini), checked in that order.
